skill.name: git-pr-workflows-onboard
skill.description: Creates structured onboarding plans for engineering teams, including Git workflows, pull request expectations, access setup, mentorship, and 30-60-90 day milestones.
skill.summary: Plan developer onboarding for Git, pull request, and team workflow adoption.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: New engineering hires need clear access, learning, and contribution milestones. This skill creates structured onboarding plans for Git, PR, and team workflow integration.
actual_capabilities: Creates pre-arrival, day-one, week-one, and 30-60-90 day onboarding plans.
Maps Git, pull request, review, CI, deployment, and documentation learning tasks.
Defines access setup checklists for accounts, development tools, and team systems.
Structures buddy, manager, and team check-ins for remote or hybrid hires.
Adapts onboarding intensity for junior, mid-level, senior, and lead engineers.
limitations: Does not provision real accounts, credentials, hardware, or system access.
Requires team-specific context to produce accurate schedules and milestones.
Does not replace HR, legal, compliance, or security approval processes.
Does not verify whether a new hire completed each task.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Engineer Start Plan
use_cases.description: Create a practical onboarding schedule before a developer joins the team.

use_cases.title: Standardize Pull Request Training
use_cases.description: Turn Git and review expectations into clear learning tasks and milestones.

use_cases.title: Support Remote Team Integration
use_cases.description: Plan buddy sessions, introductions, documentation work, and feedback checkpoints for distributed hires.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Onboarding Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single new hire.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a two-week onboarding plan for a new backend engineer. Include Git setup, first PR goals, buddy check-ins, and manager milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Customize by Role and Location
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 30-day onboarding plan for a remote senior frontend engineer joining a six-person product team. Include access setup, architecture sessions, review expectations, and measurable outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a PR Workflow Ramp
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request focused on engineering workflow adoption.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pull request workflow ramp for a mid-level engineer. Cover branching, reviews, CI checks, deployment awareness, documentation, and success criteria for weeks one through four.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Improve an Existing Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this onboarding plan for gaps in Git workflow training, access readiness, mentorship, and 30-60-90 day milestones. Return prioritized improvements and missing checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Onboard a remote backend engineer starting next Monday.
output_examples.output: A staged plan with pre-arrival setup, day-one orientation, development environment tasks, first PR targets, buddy meetings, and a day-30 checkpoint.

output_examples.input: Improve our PR onboarding for junior developers.
output: A week-one Git and branching checklist.
A guided first pull request path with buddy review.
A review-quality rubric and milestone tracking plan.

output_examples.input: Create an accelerated plan for a lead engineer.
output_examples.output: A four-week ramp covering architecture immersion, stakeholder meetings, process assessment, technical ownership, and first roadmap contributions.

best_practices: Provide role, seniority, start date, location, and team context before asking for a plan.
Keep credential handling inside approved company systems and security workflows.
Review milestones with the manager, buddy, and new hire after each checkpoint.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to create or share real credentials.
Do not use a generic schedule without adapting it to the team and role.
Do not treat onboarding completion as only a checklist without feedback.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create structured onboarding plans for engineering hires who need Git, PR, team, and workflow ramp-up.

faq.question: Can it provision accounts or credentials?
faq.answer: No. It can list access needs, but approved company systems must handle real provisioning and credentials.

faq.question: Does it support remote onboarding?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes remote-friendly check-ins, buddy sessions, documentation tasks, and async communication planning.

faq.question: Can it help with senior engineer onboarding?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes accelerated paths for senior and lead engineers, including architecture review and ownership milestones.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide role, level, start date, location, team structure, tech stack, and special onboarding goals.

faq.question: Is this only for software engineers?
faq.answer: It is strongest for engineering roles, but parts can help technical product, QA, DevOps, and support roles.
